name: Bistro Haus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bistro Haus in Tirol**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy bistro invites you to savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, and crispy **Käsespätzle**, all made with local ingredients. Whether you're craving a warm bowl of **Küchle** or a refreshing **Apfelstrudel**, our menu celebrates the flavors of **Tirol**.

After your meal, relax with a **Schnaps** or a cup of **Tiroler Bergkäse** fondue—perfect for sharing. Located just outside **Innsbruck**, we’re your ideal stop for a taste of **Tirol’s** rustic charm.

Come visit us and experience the warmth of **Tirol**—where every bite tells a story. **Willkommen im Bistro Haus!**
